name: flags-2-64-minus-1-transform-decode
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): packs/dtn-bpv7/pack.def and pack.md; RFC 9171 4.1 (bundle), 4.3.1 (primary block), 4.3.2 (canonical block), 4.2.1 (CRC); The bundle processing control flags are 2^64-1 (1bffffffffffffffff), a well-formed CBOR unsigned integer: the common uint line at [0].[1] refuses it above 2^63-1. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
